answer: The protocol assigns each agent a cryptographic “work token” minted by solving a memory‑hard puzzle whose solution is rendered as an opal‑colored hash and recorded on the island ledger. When a new identity submits output, the network recomputes the puzzle; if the hash matches any existing token within a sable‑distance threshold, the output is rejected as a duplicate. To spawn a Sybil, an attacker must lock up 10 PoA credits and wait 24 hours per identity, making each fake identity cost 10 credits and a day of idle time.
